what.text: This page follows refugees from Pakistan living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3896 Pakistani refugees in France, 4.3% of all refugees from Pakistan.
Afghanistan hosts the most Pakistani refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan in 1990, 1994 to 1996 and every year from 2007 to 2025, with the TTP among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2004 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group in some years since 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 142 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
